skill.name: orchestrator-agent
skill.description: Coordinates Unite-Hub workflows by validating blockers, routing work to specialist agents, tracking state, handling errors, and producing audit-ready status reports.
skill.summary: Coordinate Unite-Hub agent workflows with validation, state tracking, and clear reporting.
skill.author: CleanExpo

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences being classified as Ruby or shell backticks. No prompt injection or malicious exfiltration intent was found in SKILL.md. Semantic review found medium risks around unredacted error context logging and generic system-user approval attribution.

remediation.issue: Audit logs may store stack traces and raw workflow context.
remediation.suggestion: Redact PII, secrets, tokens, email content, and internal paths before writing audit logs.

remediation.issue: Content approval examples use a generic system user.
remediation.suggestion: Record the requesting user, enforce authorization checks, and reserve service identity for background execution.

remediation.issue: Workflow examples mention running agent scripts.
remediation.suggestion: Use fixed allowlisted scripts and require user confirmation before executing local commands.

semantic_findings.title: Sensitive Error Context Logging
semantic_findings.description: The error logging template includes error messages, stack traces, and context in audit events. Without redaction, this can expose contact details, email content, API errors, or internal paths.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Lines 293-300 explicitly include stack_trace and context in audit details. The exact stored data depends on implementation, so confidence is high but not absolute.

semantic_findings.title: Generic System User Approval Attribution
semantic_findings.description: The approval workflow uses userId=system when approving content drafts. If implemented directly, this can weaken user accountability and authorization checks.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Line 146 explicitly names a system user for approvals, and this file does not describe permission checks. The risk depends on the backing application implementation.

content.value_statement: Complex Unite-Hub work can lose context across email, content, audit, and health checks. This skill validates blockers first, routes work to specialist agents, and reports progress clearly.
actual_capabilities: Routes requested work through blocker validation before specialist execution.
Coordinates email-agent and content-agent pipeline steps.
Defines workflow memory keys for state tracking across runs.
Outlines health checks for data integrity, audit logs, and agent status.
Classifies recoverable, significant, and critical workflow errors.
Provides report templates for pipeline completion and system health.
limitations: Requires the underlying Unite-Hub agents, database, memory table, and audit system.
Provides orchestration guidance, not executable implementation code.
Needs explicit safeguards before approving content or scheduling sends.
Lists Claude API reasoning as a future integration point.

use_cases.title: Run Email-To-Content Pipelines
use_cases.description: Coordinate email processing, lead scoring, content generation, and completion reporting in one workflow.

use_cases.title: Check Unite-Hub Health
use_cases.description: Review data integrity, recent audit activity, database status, and agent performance before starting work.

use_cases.title: Manage Content Approvals
use_cases.description: Fetch draft content, validate contact readiness, approve selected items, and prepare scheduling reports.

prompt_templates.title: Run A Basic Status Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the current Unite-Hub workflow status and summarize active blockers, pending content, and next recommended actions.

prompt_templates.title: Process Warm Leads
prompt_templates.prompt: Process new emails, identify warm leads with high AI scores, generate draft follow-up content, and report the results.

prompt_templates.title: Approve Selected Drafts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the top five draft content items, verify each contact is ready, ask for approval, then prepare a scheduling summary.

prompt_templates.title: Audit And Recover A Failing Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Run a full system audit, classify each error by severity, identify the root cause, and propose a recovery plan with owner and timeline.

output_examples.input: Run the full email and content workflow for warm leads.
output: Workflow started after blocker validation passed.
Email processing completed with processed, updated, and skipped counts.
Draft content was generated for qualified leads and queued for review.
Recommended next action is to review pending drafts before scheduling sends.

output_examples.input: Run system audit before content approval.
output: Health status summarizes data integrity, recent audit activity, database checks, and agent performance.
Critical blockers are listed first with root cause and estimated resolution time.
The report separates safe next steps from actions that should wait.

output_examples.input: Approve all content for two named contacts.
output: The orchestrator finds matching drafts and validates contact readiness.
It records approval decisions, updates follow-up timing, and produces an audit-friendly summary.
Items that fail validation remain in draft status with reasons.

best_practices: Run blocker validation before starting multi-agent workflows.
Confirm content approvals with an authorized user before changing draft status.
Review audit and memory outputs after each long-running pipeline.
anti_patterns: Do not execute workflow commands without checking system health first.
Do not store raw stack traces, secrets, or email content in audit logs.
Do not approve or schedule generated content without contact validation.

faq.question: What does this skill coordinate?
faq.answer: It coordinates Unite-Hub email processing, content generation, approval, audit, memory, and health-check workflows.

faq.question: Does it include executable code?
faq.answer: No. The skill provides workflow instructions and report templates, not runnable scripts or source code.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Can it approve content automatically?
faq.answer: It describes approval steps, but production use should require authorized user confirmation and full audit attribution.

faq.question: How does it handle failures?
faq.answer: It classifies errors as recoverable, significant, or critical and describes matching retry, alert, or halt actions.

faq.question: What systems are required?
faq.answer: It expects Unite-Hub specialist agents, Convex database access, audit logging, and persistent memory support.
